title: Add five reviewed silicate and secondary-resource records
selection: Five additions raise the catalogue from 374 to 379 records. Phlogopite and stevensite retain source-scoped biological observations, while sauconite and the two secondary resources retain explicitly abiotic experiments. Mineral identities, uncertain phase status and waste-feed compositions remain distinct; criticality and deployment are not inherited.
limitations: Phlogopite retains a nonsignificant potassium-concentration contrast and missing aged abiotic controls. Stevensite retains its questionable IMA status and the actual source-defined material and experimental limitations. Sauconite synthesis does not establish microbial formation. The capacitor and SmCo records preserve conflicting source values and recipes; solution mobilization is not automatically isolated product recovery, and the SmCo supplement does not establish a reconciled overall yield.
issue_summary: [Issue #260](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/260) tracks the corrected SmCo precipitation-methods locator; [issue #263](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/263) tracks the corrected stevensite primary-source and supplement locators. Both initial observations and explicit successor dispositions are preserved, with canonical EDIT sessions. Initial and corrected batch gates are retained separately. [Issue #261](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/261) and [issue #262](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/262) retain unresolved source contradictions. [Issue #256](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/256) remains open: the new phlogopite study does not substitute for the outstanding 2019 bacterial phlogopite and 2021 sepiolite originals. These external evidence gaps are not silently resolved by narrower accepted records.
